lines: Up to end of nāda having uttered, Kaula-lord body-resembling; having occupied first wheel in sky in machine foot-pressed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nādiphāntaṃ samuccārya kauleśaṃ dehasaṃnibham ākramya prathamaṃ cakraṃ khe yantre pādapīḍitam
